offering_description.value: TIC Solutions provides testing, inspection, certification, compliance and engineering services to industrial, energy, utility and infrastructure clients, including data center operators. It supports assets from design and commissioning through operation, using field inspections, laboratory testing, proprietary software and drone-based analysis.

quotes.quote: TIC Solutions serves diversified end markets that are essential to the broader economy, including industrials, energy processing, utilities, and both public and commercial infrastructure, with exposure to data centers and other high-growth adjacencies. As the parent company of Acuren and NV5, we integrate deep domain expertise, local presence, and global standards to solve our clients’ most complex challenges.

From infrastructure and building systems design and commissioning to testing, inspection, and compliance, TIC Solutions supports the entire lifecycle of assets and infrastructure through comprehensive solutions for engineering design, advanced inspection and nondestructive testing (NDT), Rope Access Technician (RAT) mitigation services, materials engineering services, lab analysis and destructive testing, proprietary software, and drone-enabled geospatial analytics.

primary_services.value: Testing, inspection, certification and compliance, including nondestructive testing; engineering design, commissioning and owner representation; rope-access mitigation; materials engineering and laboratory testing; drone-based geospatial analysis

TIC Solutions’ engineers, project managers, and technical experts specialize in facility design, commissioning, and owner representation to ensure that assets operate reliably and efficiently.
